RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  the March 12, 2007/Phalguna 21, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Earth Sciences; Food Processing Industries; Human Resource
Development; Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable
Energy; Power; Science and Technology; Social Justice and Empowerment;
Tribal Affairs; Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
59
Changes in RGGVY and APDRP
† *181. SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a)  whether Rajeev Gandhi Grameen
Vidyutikaran Yojana (RGGVY) and
Accelerated Power Development and
Reform Programme (APDRP) have not
yielded desired results;
(b)  if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government are
considering to bring about some changes in
these schemes in order to make them more
meaningful; and
(d)  if so, the details thereof?
Kutir Jyoti Programme
 *182. SHRI SITARAM YECHURY:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a)  whether the Finance Minister in his
budget speech for 2006-07 had stated that
all the un-electrified rural BPL households
would be provided electricity connection
free of charge as per norms of Kutir Jyoti
Programme; and
(b)  if so, the percentage of BPL
households covered under Kutir Jyoti
Programme till 2005-06?
Schemes for girl education
 *183. DR. GYAN PRAKASH
PILANIA: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT  be
pleased to state:
(a)  what steps and which schemes, have
been announced by Centre/States to give
fillip to girl students and also to encourage
female education;
(b)  the funds sanctioned and
achievements, made thereof, during the last
three years in the country;
(c)  whether any quota has been reserved
for girl students from primary to university
level;
(d)  if so, the details thereof; and
(e)  the present status of female
education in the country, State-wise?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

60
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
 Implementation of the Tribal Rights
Bill
 *184. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of TRIBAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a)  whether  Government have
appointed a Committee of retired officials
to suggest rules for implementing the Tribal
Rights Bill;
(b)  the purpose of this Committee;
(c)  whether Government are facing a
shortage of talent in framing rules;
(d)  if so, the steps proposed to fix a
strict time limit of three months for the
said Committee to be wound up; and
(e)  the measures proposed to evolve a
balanced and sustainable set of rules?
Skill  Development Mission
† *185. SHRI RAM  JETHMALANI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
 Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that Government
have a proposal to set up Skill Development
Mission in the country;
(b)  if so, the outlines of the proposal;
(c)  whether it is also a fact that
additional measures are required to meet
the requirement of skilled workers for the
developing industries in the country;
(d)  if so, the reaction of Government
thereto; and
(e)  by when the proposal for setting
up of said mission is likely to be
implemented?
 Beggar homes
 *186. SHRI MAHMOOD A.
MADANI:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
 Will the Minister of SOCIAL
JUSTICE AND EMPOWERMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the beggar homes,
State-wise;
(b)  the steps taken to rehabilitate the
beggars;
(c)  the number of beggars actually
rehabilitated through these beggar homes
during the last three years;
(d) whether Government have any
scheme to provide micro credits to such
rehabilitated beggars;
(e)  if so, the details of number of beggars
that have been provided with such credit;
and
(f) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Power allotted to Madhya Pradesh
†*187. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY:
SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
 Will the Minister of POWER be
pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that 300 megawatt
of electricity had been allocated to Madhya
Pradesh from central power plants of
eastern areas as on July, 2002;
(b)  whether supply of power being
made to the State has been reduced to 50
megawatts;
(c)  if so, the reasons for reducing the
power supply; and
(d)  by when the supply of power
would be resumed as per earlier allotment?
